result.title: PREEMPT: Proactive Robustness Evaluation under Editing for Media Protection Techniques
result.summary: Proactive image protection methods aim to defend visual content against unauthorized manipulation and generative misuse by embedding protective signals into images before release. Evaluating whether these protections remain effective under image editing is therefore critical. However, existing evaluations remain largely limited to one-shot edits, providing only a static view of robustness while overlooking its evolution under realistic multi-step editing workflows. To systematically characterize robustness dynamics under sequential editing across various protection paradigms, we introduce PREEMPT, a holistic evaluation framework. It evaluates protection robustness under both one-shot and sequential editing scenarios, covering image transformations, semantic edits, homogeneous and heterogeneous edit compositions. To enable consistent analysis across protection paradigms with different underlying objectives, PREEMPT normalizes task-specific effectiveness into protection survival trajectories and summarizes long-horizon robustness through trajectory-based diagnostics. Using this framework, we reveal that degradation behaviors remain hidden under conventional one-shot evaluation. Furthermore, perturbation- and watermark-based protection methods exhibit different failure modes, and the first semantic edit largely determines subsequent degradation trajectories. PREEMPT provides a standardized protocol for studying long-horizon robustness and offers new insights into the degradation dynamics of proactive image protection.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PREEMPT 评估框架，把主动图像保护方法在单步与顺序多步编辑下的效果归一化为「保护生存轨迹」，用以刻画长时程鲁棒性动态，并揭示扰动式与水印式保护的失效模式差异。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但其用多步序列上的轨迹式诊断替代单步静态评估，可能为评估 latent 推理状态随推理步数退化、以及长度泛化的评价设计提供借鉴线索，具体迁移可行性有待核查。
